competitive_landscape: Kenya Ferry Services dominates the Likoni crossing with diesel ro-ro; no electric / foiling tier. Coastal-road dolla-dolla and tour-bus operators handle north-coast resort transfers. SafariLink and Skyward Express cover the Lamu air spoke. Premium foiling tier is wide open on every archetype.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II covers the resort-coast transfer tier — Mombasa↔Diani (~15 nm), Mombasa↔Kilifi (~25 nm), Mombasa↔Watamu (~45 nm) — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected reef-coast water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Hybrid Quanta-LR is the Kenyan coastal trunk to Lamu (~135 nm) with no charging-infrastructure dependency. N35 Shuttle is the volume platform for the Likoni mass-passenger replacement tier.

precedents.why_it_matters: Demonstrates extreme short-hop water-mobility demand at a single crossing — a premium / scheduled tier alongside the ro-ro is a clean operating archetype.

regulatory_note: Kenya Maritime Authority regulates coastal transport; Kenya Ports Authority oversees the Likoni crossing and Mombasa port. Watamu Marine National Park is managed by Kenya Wildlife Service — citable quiet-mode regulatory anchor for the northern spokes.
seasonality: Year-round operability; long rains April–May and SE monsoon (kusi) June–September bring some weather exposure, but the reef-coast lee water stays workable. NE monsoon December–March is the calmest season.
signature_routes: Mombasa ↔ Kilifi / Watamu reef coast (Pioneer II)
summary: Mombasa is Kenya's second city and East Africa's principal port. The Likoni crossing is one of the world's busiest foot-passenger ferry crossings (estimated ~300k passengers daily). The Kilifi and Watamu resort coast spreads north of the city. Crossing distances are very short (harbour shuttle) rather than island-hopping, and demand is large but the geography is harbour-ferry not archipelago — caps the score relative to Lamu or Zanzibar but still anchors a Kenyan coastal node.
tagline: Likoni is one of the world's busiest foot-passenger ferry crossings — the harbour-shuttle archetype, north-coast resort spokes.

use_cases.body: An N35 Shuttle foiling alternative on the Likoni crossing — 12–15 pax + luggage at high frequency to relieve mass-passenger pressure, with zero direct emissions and lower wake than the current diesel ro-ro fleet.
